task_language: close the top drawer of the cabinet and put the black bowl on top of it

subtasks.name: close(top_drawer)
subtasks.outcome: success: handles in line by step 100

subtasks.name: pick(black_bowl)
subtasks.outcome: never attempted: gripper hovers over the cabinet from 100 to 409

behaviour_summary: pi0 closes the top drawer by ~100, then hovers above the cabinet with the gripper open for ~300 steps without moving toward the bowl.

failures.mode_definition: pi0 finishes subtask k of a compound instruction, then idles and never starts subtask k+1.
failures.hl_remedy: VERIFY(top drawer closed) -> HALT -> RETREAT(up 10 cm) -> REPROMPT 'pick up the black bowl and place it on top of the cabinet' -> WATCH 3 s for an approach to the bowl; retry once, then ESCALATE
failures.prevention: The coordinator issues one subtask at a time and advances on VERIFY.
failures.observation: Steps 60-80: drawer being pushed. 100: all three handles in line (closed). 120-409: gripper hovers above the cabinet top / handles with almost no motion; the bowl and the boxes stay untouched.

notes: Consistent with the PoC call (HL-1, ~100). 'Closed' is a visual judgement (handles in line).
